conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="whim-server" AND logName:"run.googleapis.com%2Fstdout" AND jsonPayload.scope="report" AND jsonPayload.msg="report accepted"

documentation.content: Report ${log.extracted_label.reportId}, reason ${log.extracted_label.reason}. Read it from a laptop with `node server/admin.mjs reports show ${log.extracted_label.reportId}` (docs/deploy.md, Firestore stores: Operator commands from a laptop). At most one email per 5 minutes: `node server/admin.mjs reports list` shows any others.
